description: Send GEODE from `signer` to another account (keep-alive transfer: your account can never be emptied below the minimum balance). Irreversible, so the first call returns a confirm_token and the real cost; call again with it to get the intent. Sign with geode-local-signer, restating the recipient and amount in `expect`, then submit with geode_submit_intent. Sending to a new address creates that account (at least 1 GEODE). Counts toward the per-transaction and rolling 24-hour caps.

amount.description: Amount in GEODE as a decimal string (e.g. "1.25"), or {"raw": "<planck>"}

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_balances_transfer
title: Send GEODE
